scenario_1.name: Solo Traveler Weekend Getaway
scenario_1.description: A quick, efficient, budget-friendly weekend exploration maximizing sightseeing and local food without transit friction.

itinerary.title: Solo Explorer: Vibrant Barcelona in 48 Hours
itinerary.trip_summary: An optimized 2-day solo itinerary connecting Antoni Gaudí's architectural marvels, lively tapas markets, and panoramic coastal views with low transit overhead.

logistics.airport_transfer_tip: Take the Aerobús directly to Plaça de Catalunya (approx 35 mins, €6.75).
logistics.local_transport_pass: 10-journey T-Casual metro ticket covers all city center zones.
logistics.safety_notes: Barcelona is very safe for solo travelers; stay mindful of personal belongings around Las Ramblas and crowded metro stations.

days.summary: Begin with the breathtaking Sagrada Família, stroll through Passeig de Gràcia, and wrap up with tapas in the medieval Gothic Quarter.

activities.title: Basílica de la Sagrada Família
activities.description: Marvel at Gaudí's soaring basilica interior bathed in morning stained-glass light. Includes audio guide tour.
activities.booking_tip: Book timed-entry tickets online at least 5 days in advance; morning slots have fewer crowds.

activities.title: Mercat de la Boqueria & Solo Tapas Lunch
activities.description: Head into Europe's most famous produce market. Grab counter seating at Bar Pinotxo or El Quim de la Boqueria for grilled baby squid and tortilla.
activities.booking_tip: Counter seats are first-come first-served; perfect for solo travelers.
activities.transit_info: 15 min metro ride via L3 to Liceu station.

activities.title: Gothic Quarter (Barri Gòtic) Photo Walk
activities.description: Explore labyrinthine cobblestone alleys, the Barcelona Cathedral, Plaça del Rei, and hidden artisan workshops.
activities.booking_tip: Keep phone charged for photos; golden hour light across the ancient stone facades is incredible.

activities.title: El Born Tapas & Vermouth Experience
activities.description: Relax at Tapeo or Cal Pep with local Catalan red wine, patatas bravas, and jamón ibérico.
activities.booking_tip: Spanish dinners start after 8:30 PM. Arrive right at opening to claim solo bar spots easily.
activities.transit_info: 10 minute stroll east from Gothic Quarter.

days.summary: Ascend to Gaudí's whimsical park hillside, descend through the bohemian Gràcia quarter, and celebrate the finale along Barceloneta beach.

activities.title: Park Güell Monumental Zone
activities.description: Wander among the serpentine mosaic benches, Hansel-and-Gretel porter pavilions, and panoramic sweeping views of the city.
activities.booking_tip: Book the 9:30 AM entry to beat mid-day tourist buses.
activities.transit_info: Bus 24 directly from Plaça de Catalunya to Park Güell entrance.

activities.title: Gràcia Neighborhood Exploration & Cafe Lunch
activities.description: Descend the hills into Vila de Gràcia. Dine on artisanal Catalan sandwiches and organic salads at Cafe Federal or Plaça del Sol.
activities.booking_tip: Sit outdoors on the piazza for relaxed people-watching.
activities.transit_info: 15 minute gentle downhill walk from Park Güell.

activities.title: Barceloneta Beach Promenade & Sunset Drinks
activities.description: Take the metro down to the coast. Walk along the Mediterranean boardwalk, watch seaside volleyball, and catch the sunset with a chilled sangria.
activities.booking_tip: Great spot for an evening jog or relaxed photography.

activities.title: Solo Paella Tasting at 7 Portes or Can Ros
activities.description: Authentic seafood paella cooked over gas flames. Celebrate the final night of your weekend journey.
activities.booking_tip: Reserve online 24 hours prior or ask for single diner table upon opening.

scenario_2.name: Couple Personalized Romantic Vacation
scenario_2.description: A relaxed, scenic, premium vacation focusing on intimate dining, scenic vistas, boutique ambiance, and zero rush.

itinerary.title: Romantic Escape: Clifftop Splendor & Amalfi Serenade
itinerary.trip_summary: A 3-day romantic journey curated with private cliffside dining, tranquil boat cruises along the pastel shores, scenic walks, and Italian coastal elegance.

logistics.best_transit_mode: Private chauffeured Mercedes van & scenic ferry
logistics.airport_transfer_tip: Fly into Naples Capodichino (NAP); pre-book private coastal transfer directly to your Positano boutique hotel.
logistics.local_transport_pass: Ferry passes between Positano, Amalfi, and Capri provide the most relaxing journey avoiding coastal traffic.
logistics.safety_notes: Very tranquil and secure region. Watch your step on damp cliffside stone stairs.

days.theme: Arrival & Sunset Cocktails over Positano Bay
days.summary: Check into cliffside boutique hotel, stroll through cascaded bougainvillea streets, and dine at a candlelit terrace overlooking the sea.

activities.title: Check-in at Cliffside Boutique Villa & Spianata Stroll
activities.description: Unpack and sip complimentary welcome prosecco on your private balcony overlooking the Mediterranean sea.
activities.booking_tip: Request high floor cliff-view suite with private terrace.
activities.transit_info: Private driver drop-off at pedestrian lane.

activities.title: Sunset Cocktails at Franco's Bar
activities.description: Iconic al fresco terrace bar with sweeping vistas, bespoke spritzes, and romantic golden hour ambience.
activities.booking_tip: No reservations accepted; arrive 30 minutes before sunset for the premier front-rail seats.

activities.title: Candlelit Seafood Dinner at Ristorante Max
activities.description: Fine art gallery restaurant set in a historic courtyard. Fresh handmade pasta, catch of the day, and sommelier-paired regional wines.
activities.booking_tip: Ask for the intimate garden courtyard table.
activities.transit_info: Gentle downhill stroll through the village.

days.theme: Private Capri Boat Charter & Blue Grotto
days.summary: Full day chartered private boat excursion around Capri's legendary Faraglioni rock formations and secluded swimming coves.

activities.title: Private Gozzo Boat Charter along Capri Shoreline
activities.description: Board a classic wooden Italian Gozzo boat with private skipper. Cruise past Sirenuse islands, White Grotto, and iconic Faraglioni arches.
activities.booking_tip: Towels, prosecco, and snorkeling gear included on board.

activities.title: Cliffside Lunch at La Fontelina Capri
activities.description: World-famous beach club restaurant nestled directly opposite the Faraglioni rocks. Savor spaghetti alle vongole and chilled sangria.
activities.booking_tip: Boat drops you off directly at the private rock slipway.

activities.title: Intimate Dinner at Rada Rooftop Positano
activities.description: Sensational cliffside rooftop dining hovering directly above the gentle waves of Spiaggia Grande.
activities.booking_tip: Book table 1 month in advance for unobstructed waterfront views.

days.summary: Ascend to high-altitude Ravello, wander through Villa Cimbrone's Terrace of Infinity, and enjoy organic wine tasting overlooking the gulf.

activities.title: Villa Cimbrone & Infinity Terrace
activities.description: Stroll lush English gardens leading to the 'Terrazza dell'Infinito' marble bust balcony perched 1,200 feet above the sapphire Mediterranean.
activities.booking_tip: Undoubtedly the most romantic photo opportunity in Southern Europe.
activities.transit_info: Scenic 35-min private car ride along the coastline.

activities.title: Private Marisa Cuomo Winery Tasting & Cellar Lunch
activities.description: Taste extreme clifftop wines harvested from steep vertical rocks. 4-course food and wine pairing overlooking Furore fjord.
activities.booking_tip: Reservation required; includes sommelier guide through rock cellars.
activities.transit_info: Private transfer between Ravello and Furore.

activities.title: Farewell Starlight Toast at Hotel Sirenuse Terrace
activities.description: Wrap up your romantic getaway under 400 flickering candles with champagne and gourmet desserts.
activities.booking_tip: Smart elegant dress code enforced.

scenario_3.name: Small Group Coordinating a Multi-Day Trip
scenario_3.description: Multi-day adventure balancing group activities, shared transport logistics, budget split tracking, and scheduled free time.

itinerary.title: Kyoto & Osaka Group Odyssey: Ancient Shrines to Neon Alleys
itinerary.trip_summary: A 4-day coordinated group journey structured to maximize shared experiences while providing split logistics, food flexibility for all diets, and seamless bullet train connectivity.

logistics.best_transit_mode: JR Shinkansen bullet train + ICOCA contactless transit cards
logistics.airport_transfer_tip: Kansai Airport (KIX) -> Take Haruka Express train directly to Kyoto Station (75 mins). Group of 4 can pre-reserve reserved car seats together.
logistics.local_transport_pass: ICOCA cards loaded with ¥5,000 each for seamless subway and bus boarding without group queue delays.
packing_tips: Easy slip-off shoes for temple visits
Pocket Wi-Fi device or dual e-SIMs for group messaging
logistics.safety_notes: Extremely safe for groups. Ensure group members save meeting points in Google Maps if splitting up for shopping.

days.summary: Explore western Kyoto's scenic bamboo corridors, cross the Togetsukyo bridge, and encounter wild macaque monkeys with scenic river views.

activities.title: Arashiyama Bamboo Forest & Tenryu-ji Temple
activities.description: Walk together through towering bamboo stalks in crisp morning air, then visit the UNESCO zen landscape gardens of Tenryu-ji.
activities.booking_tip: Start at 8:30 AM to take group photos before crowds arrive.
activities.transit_info: JR San-in Line from Kyoto Station to Saga-Arashiyama (17 mins).

activities.title: Group Yuba & Soba Feast at Arashiyama Yoshimura
activities.description: Handmade buckwheat soba with tempura and tofu skin specialties. Accommodates vegetarian preference with dedicated vegetarian sets.
activities.booking_tip: Large group tatami room with Oi River panorama.

activities.title: Kinkaku-ji (The Golden Pavilion)
activities.description: Group visit to the shimmering gold-leaf Zen temple mirrored across the surrounding Kyoko-chi pond.
activities.booking_tip: Taxis for a group of 4 from Arashiyama to Kinkaku-ji cost almost the same as 4 bus fares and save 40 mins.

activities.title: Gion Historic Lantern Walk & Izakaya Dinner
activities.description: Walk through Pontocho Alley lit by paper lanterns. Enjoy shared skewered yakitori, edamame, and craft Japanese beers.
activities.booking_tip: Split bill evenly across group members via contactless payments.
activities.transit_info: Subway Tozai line to Sanjo Keihan.

days.theme: Thousands of Torii Gates & Nishiki Food Market
days.summary: Climb through the vermilion gates of Fushimi Inari, taste dozens of local street foods at Nishiki Market, and visit Kiyomizu-dera.

activities.title: Fushimi Inari-taisha Torii Path Hike
activities.description: Hike the 4-kilometer trail winding through thousands of crimson torii gates up sacred Mount Inari.
activities.booking_tip: Free entry. Stop halfway at Yotsutsuji intersection for Kyoto city views.
activities.transit_info: JR Nara line from Kyoto Station (5 mins).

activities.title: Nishiki Market Culinary Grazing Tour
activities.description: Known as 'Kyoto's Kitchen'. Sample grilled wagyu skewers, matcha ice cream, dashi tamagoyaki, and pickled vegetables.
activities.booking_tip: Group members can sample freely at independent stalls.

activities.title: Kiyomizu-dera Wooden Stage & Sunset Panorama
activities.description: Historic wooden temple built without a single nail hanging out over cherry blossom and maple trees.
activities.booking_tip: Drink from Otowa Waterfall's three streams for health, longevity, or success in studies.
activities.transit_info: Uphill walk through Ninenzaka & Sannenzaka preserved streets.

activities.title: Traditional Kaiseki or Shabu-Shabu Dinner
activities.description: Multi-course seasonal Japanese dining with paper hot-pots, vegetables, and tofu hot stone cooking.
activities.booking_tip: Pre-advised vegetarian broth option confirmed for group member.

days.theme: Osaka Castle & Dotonbori Street Food Extravaganza
days.summary: Bullet train transfer into Osaka. Explore historic Osaka Castle gardens and immerse in Dotonbori's neon nightlife and street food.

activities.title: Shinkansen Transit & Osaka Castle Park
activities.description: Fast 15-minute Shinkansen to Shin-Osaka. Drop bags and explore the grand moat, stone walls, and museum tower of Osaka Castle.
activities.booking_tip: Store luggage at Shin-Osaka lockers or check in early.

activities.title: Shinsekai Retro District & Kushikatsu Lunch
activities.description: Nostalgic 1912 Osaka neighborhood beneath Tsutenkaku Tower. Savor deep-fried crispy skewers (veggies, cheese, seafood, meats).
activities.booking_tip: Remember the golden Osaka rule: never double-dip in the communal sauce tray!
activities.transit_info: Osaka Loop Line to Shin-Imamiya station.

activities.title: Umeda Sky Building Floating Garden Observatory
activities.description: Futuristic twin towers connected by an open-air 360-degree observation deck 173 meters above the city.
activities.booking_tip: Time your arrival 45 minutes prior to sunset to catch dusk transitioning to neon city lights.

activities.title: Dotonbori Neon Canal Walk & Okonomiyaki Feast
activities.description: Pose under the legendary Glico Running Man billboard, sample piping-hot takoyaki octo-balls, and enjoy savory cabbage pancakes.
activities.booking_tip: Book a group booth at Mizuno or Chibo okonomiyaki.
activities.transit_info: Subway Midosuji line to Namba station.

days.theme: Universal Studios Japan or Cultural Shopping & Departure
days.summary: Flexible final day: Group visits Super Nintendo World / Wizarding World of Harry Potter or explores Nipponbashi Den-Den Town before flight.

activities.title: Super Nintendo World at Universal Studios Japan
activities.description: Interactive real-world Mario Kart experience, punching Coin Blocks with power-up bands, and exploring Bowser's Castle.
activities.booking_tip: Express passes recommended for groups to enter timed-area Nintendo World together.
activities.transit_info: JR Yumesaki Line to Universal City Station.

activities.title: Shinsaibashi-suji Souvenir Shopping & Group Farewell Lunch
activities.description: Covered 600m shopping arcade. Pick up Japanese snacks, green tea treats, and enjoy a farewell ramen / udon lunch.
activities.booking_tip: Tax-free shopping available with your passports.

activities.title: Nankai Rapi:t Express to Kansai Airport (KIX)
activities.description: Board the futuristic blue retro Nankai Rapi:t express train directly to KIX airport for your departure flight.
activities.booking_tip: Comfortable reserved seats with dedicated luggage bays for the entire group.
